summary: Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. (Gas Transporter of the South Inc) filed a routine Form 6-K furnishing its condensed interim consolidated financial statements as of September 30, 2026, together with management's analysis of financial condition and results of operations for the nine-month period then ended. The filing contains no transaction, no stake, price, premium, or board recommendation, and no advisor is named. It is an ordinary foreign-issuer periodic report prepared under IAS 34 with IAS 29 hyperinflationary restatement; no special-situation mechanics or deal terms apply.
